author: The Infographics Show
description:
OpenAI became one of the most important companies in the AI revolution. But as its losses mount and competitors gain ground, Sam Altman faces a question that could determine the company’s future - who will keep paying for it?

This video explores the financial pressure behind ChatGPT’s explosive growth. OpenAI has attracted millions of users and major corporate customers, yet the cost of running and expanding its AI infrastructure continues to rise. Meanwhile, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, and open-source models are giving businesses more alternatives to expensive proprietary AI services. Even Microsoft, OpenAI’s longtime partner and major backer, is developing more of its own AI technology. That raises a difficult question: what happens when the companies funding the AI boom begin building alternatives to the companies they fund?

title: Sam Altman is panicking...
